steps.title: In Canada
steps.body: Use the time and the place to make the meal clear: le dîner à midi; le souper à 18 h. In this course, the Québec/Canadian meal names are the main forms to recognize and use in a Canadian setting. The words vary by region, so listen for the local meaning.
